title: Training as Data Analyst
longdescription: Since January 2026, I have been following multiple online courses on Data Analysis. My main focus is on Python, but I also learned SQL and updated my knowledge of MS Excel. Furthermore, I am trying to keep up to date with the development of the artificial intelligence and its secure and ethical use. To see the list of all courses and certificates, click here.

title: Italian course
longdescription: I am continuously working on improving my Italian. To give it more structure, I decided to follow a formal language course organized by the municipality of Milan. The entrance test confirmed that my Italian is on B1 level. Hence, I am currently taking a course to reach level B2. My main target is being able to speak fluently in most situations (even if it means making errors).

title: Volunteering
longdescription: Once a week, you can find me in Tempio del Futuro Perduto in Milan, where I help with collection, sorting, and redistribution of used clothing to people in need.

title: Postdoc
longdescription: Postdoc is a research position typical for young researchers freshly out of their doctoral studies. The aim is to become more independent in their research activities, produce scientific articles, and expand their research network. I was very happy to return, even briefly, to my alma mater; this time as a member of the research group UFOCLAN. During the seven months there I focused solely on research; the result was co-authoring two research articles published in peer-reviewed journals. (Click here to see the list of all my research papers.)

title: Italian course
longdescription: After moving to Italy, I dedicated the first few months to an intensive Italian course at a private language school ELLCI. It helped me to get from nearly zero knowledge to B1 level.

title: Postdoc
longdescription: Postdoc is a research position typical for young researchers freshly out of their doctoral studies. The aim is to become more independent in their research activities, produce scientific articles, and expand their research network. At the University of Victoria, I did the second part of my PIMS-funded postdoc in Canada. My first few months there were filled with teaching Calculus to a group of circa 100 students. After that I worked with Stephen Scully; I hoped to finally crack a problem on p-forms that I had been trying to solve for several years.

title: Postdoc
longdescription: Postdoc is a research position typical for young researchers freshly out of their doctoral studies. The aim is to become more independent in their research activities, produce scientific articles, and expand their research network. Edmonton was my first stop on the two-year PIMS-funded postdoctoral fellowship in Canada. I lectured a course on Linear Algebra for math minors, in which I focused on active engagement of the students. Apart from the teaching duties, I spent most of the year polishing my PhD project and publishing it in scientific journals. As a small side project, I wrote a research paper with my former fellow PhD student Nico Lorenz; the coordination was made more difficult by the fact that our respective time zones were eight hours apart. (Click here to see the list of all my research papers.)

title: Scientific staff
longdescription:
This was a junior research position linked to my doctoral studies. My main task was to gain wide knowledge of what is already known in my research field, find gaps and try to fill them. Note that I was affected by the pandemic, as it significantly reduced the contact with my supervisor and my colleagues. This forced me to become independent in my research sooner than it is usual for a young scientist.

I also lectured several recitations (exercise classes) and I supervised students on their first seminar thesis and presentations. All of my lecturing and supervising duties were carried in German.

title: Ph.D. in Mathematics
longdescription: I moved to Germany to do a Ph.D. in Mathematics, in particular in Algebra. My supervisor was Prof. Detlev Hoffmann. My main focus was on quadratic forms over fields of characteristic 2. I defended my doctoral thesis "Equivalence relations of quadratic forms in characteristic 2 and quasilinear p-forms" on December 7, 2022, receiving the grade magna cum laude (i.e., very good, the second highest grade). Apart from mathematics, I followed workshops on didactics to understand how to teach better. I also took many German courses (I believe I completed all the C1-level courses the university offered), because I wanted to keep improving my language skills.

title: Research internship
longdescription: In 2018, I was lucky to get the opportunity of doing a short research internship with Pieter Moree at the prestigious Max-Planck Institute for Mathamatics in Bonn.

title: M.Sc. in Mathematics
longdescription: During my Master studies, I focused on Algebra. The topic of my thesis was also in the realm of Number Theory, in particular on composition of quadratic forms (over rings of algebraic integers). I graduated with distinction and the average 1.0 (the best possible). Additionally, I participated in a student Number Theory seminar that resulted into two research articles published in peer-reviewed journals. (Click here to see the list of all my research papers.) During the last semester I also lectured a recitation (an exercise class) on Linear Algebra. This was my first experience with teaching at the university level.

title: Erasmus
longdescription: After the experience from Barcelona, I decided that one Erasmus semester is not enough. I spent the winter semester of 2016/2017 in Darmstadt. Apart from math courses, I also did multiple language courses and improved my German to B2 level.

title: Erasmus
longdescription: This was my first experience of living abroad. Contrary to the common expectation, I did not have time to party. I spent most of my time in Barcelona studying and use my free time for traveling and discovering the country.

title: Designer of online lectures
longdescription: "Techambition is a company developing interactive study materials. At the time I worked there
column8: it was a small company with just a few employees focused on the Czech market
column9: but it has grown since then. My task was to design online math homeworks. The – at that time – novelty idea was in using interactive visualizations supported by guiding steps that would allow the students to examine the problem and figure out the solution on their own."
